purpose: Collect reader-submitted community stories for editorial review before publication.

fields.label: Community Area
fields.accessibility_notes: Controlled choices prevent arbitrary taxonomy creation.

fields.label: Photo Upload
fields.accessibility_notes: Visible label; allowed image types listed.

fields.label: Photo Rights Confirmation
fields.accessibility_notes: Clear consent text for image rights.

fields.label: Publication Consent
fields.accessibility_notes: Clear consent text for editorial review and possible publication.

conditional_logic.rule: required when Photo Upload has a file if supported by field logic; otherwise keep required and explain no upload is needed.

confirmations.name: Default
confirmations.message: Thanks. Your story has been submitted for editorial review.

notifications.name: Editorial notification
notifications.message: Include entry link, story title, community area, and rights/consent state. Do not attach uploaded files unless approved.

feeds.name: Optional Advanced Post Creation draft feed
feeds.condition: Only after add-on, target post type, editorial owner, media handling, and Draft/Pending Review status are approved.

spam_settings.turnstile: consider for public forms if available

accessibility_settings.label_guidance: Do not hide labels; keep long guidance in descriptions.

data_retention_notes: UGC entries contain personal data, consent records, story text, and optional uploaded images. Consent wording, editorial access, export/erase handling, and retention must be confirmed before launch.

test_data.Full Story: This is a longer test submission.

required_addons: Advanced Post Creation only if draft post creation is approved
risks: UGC can include personal data, copyrighted material, unsupported claims, and spam.
Do not auto-publish anonymous submissions without editorial approval.
Copying uploads to the Media Library requires rights and retention review.
